(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more polyisocyanates modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two distinct OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid and is derived from an aliphatic diisocyanate.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm, determined by measuring the contact angle formed with water.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating is defined as an average roughness (Ra) greater than 200 nm, as measured using atomic force microscopy.
